extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism finalization from abstract, Sections 2.4-2.8, Figure 8, Figure 9, and methods Sections 3.9-3.10.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Nicomicin-1 has direct membrane-damaging activity in the E. coli ML-35p ONPG permeability assay, with salt reducing activity; fragments did not reproduce this membrane permeabilization effect.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The mechanism is membrane damage in the assay context, not a complete in vivo target assignment.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Cell-free protein-expression testing supports a negative mechanism finding: the main antibacterial action is not inhibition of bacterial translation.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Negative translation evidence should not be converted into a separate positive intracellular-target claim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD/NMR and DPC micelle data support an amphipathic N-terminal helix plus C-terminal disulfide-stabilized loop that is membrane-associated structural context for activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural similarity to Rana-box peptides is context evidence and is not used as the sole proof of killing mechanism.
